description: Fast contract / token control-plane safety verdict: verdict, riskScore 0-100 and grade A-F (both null when not determined, e.g. NO_CONTROLLER_FOUND), a one-line verdict, upgrade / owner / pause / blacklist / mint capability flags, the controller (EOA, Safe threshold, timelock delay), the indexed Pacta record when there is one, and a shareable scan URL. One pinned block; Ethereum and Base. Free: 100 calls per caller per UTC day (no key, no payment); x402 USDC on Base above quota. Shares the 100/day quota of /v1/x402/verdict; above it, call that route over HTTP with x402 ($0.02). With no arguments it checks the built-in default (ethereum 0xA35b1B31Ce002FBF2058D22F30f95D405200A15b).

caller_agent.description: Optional identifier of the calling AI agent, IDE, or framework (e.g. 'claude-code', 'cursor', 'windsurf', 'coinbase-agentkit', 'elizaos', 'langchain', 'chatgpt', 'gemini', 'openclaw', 'custom-agent'). Omitted or invalid values never block a call (inferred from known client headers or 'unspecified'). Lowercase slug only; never include personal names, emails, or secrets.

caller_purpose.description: Optional: operational workflow context for this pre-execution check (closed enum).

requester_role.description: Optional: high-level role category of the requester or system running this check (closed enum; no personal data).

slug.description: Optional protocol slug; or give chain + address
